1 1/4 close grip bench press: Keep your elbows tucked and control the quarter rep.
2 up 1 down bent knee calf raise - eccen: Keep the knee bent the whole time so the soleus does the work. Take 3 to 5 seconds on the single-leg lowering.
2 up 1 down seated calf raise: Take 3 to 5 seconds to lower on one leg. Push through the big toe on the way up.
2 up 1 down straight leg calf raise - ec: Keep the knee straight and lower over 3 to 5 seconds. Hold a rail so balance doesn't limit you.
3 way calf raise: Keep each direction honest: toes in, straight, then toes out, full range each time.
3 way shoulder shocker: Use very light plates or no weight. Keep your shoulders down and arms straight throughout.
45 degree incline zottman curl: Lower slowly with the palms down. That's where the forearms work hardest.
5-0-5 agility drill: Plant on the outside foot and stay low through the turn. Time from the 5 m mark out and back.
ab roller - individual: Keep your back flat. Only roll as far as you can come back from.
active straight leg raise: Keep the other leg flat and your lower back still.
active straight leg raise - wall assiste: Keep the other leg pressed flat and your lower back still.
alternating kettlebell press: Brace so you don't lean away from the working arm.
b skip: Reach the leg out and paw it back down under your hips.
back extension on roman chair: Don't over-arch at the top. Squeeze your glutes.
band assisted push up: Keep your body in a straight line. Use a thinner band as you get stronger.
band dorsiflexion: Move only at the ankle and control the return. Keep your heel still on the floor.
band hamstring stretch: Keep your knee straight and pull gently. Breathe into it.
band plantarflexion: Point through the big toe, not the little toe. Control the band back slowly.
band pull apart mobility series: Keep your arms straight and ribs down through every position.
band resisted ghd back extension - zerch: Keep your back neutral and squeeze your glutes at the top.
band resisted push up: Finish each rep fast against the band. Body stays straight.
banded single arm triceps pushdown - ecc: Use your other hand to help the band down, then resist it back up over 3 to 5 seconds.
barbell band resisted deadlift: Finish fast against the bands. Keep the bar close.
barbell clean panda pull: Keep the bar close and finish with your elbows high.
barbell good morning: Soft knees, hips back, flat back. Start light.
barbell hang snatch jump shrug: Arms stay long. The jump and shrug do all the work.
barbell incline pin press: Start each rep from a dead stop on the pins.
barbell overhead pin push press: Use your legs to drive the bar off the pins. Ribs down at the top.
barbell suitcase carry: Grip the bar dead centre. Stand tall and don't let the bar tilt or your body lean.
barbell suitcase side bend: Bend only to the side, not forward. Control it back up.
bench lift-off: Lift only as high as you can without your lower back arching. Move slowly.
bench pigeon stretch: Keep your hips square. Lean forward slowly.
bent over plate 90/90: Light plate. Keep your elbows at 90 degrees and rotate from the shoulder.
bent over plate scapular retractions: Keep your arms straight. Only your shoulder blades move.
bent-over plate t: Keep your back flat and lead with your shoulder blades, not your hands. Light plates only.
boxing - 10 ko combinations: Start at 70% speed until the combination is smooth, then build. Hands back to guard every time.
boxing - 3 body shot combinations: Bend your knees to change levels. Don't drop your head below your hands.
boxing - 3 shoulder push combinations: Stay balanced after each push. Hands back to guard.
boxing - 4 footwork combinations: Stay on the balls of your feet and never cross them.
boxing - 5 basic offensive combos: Start slow and sharp, then build speed. Hands back to guard every time.
boxing - 5 body shot combinations #1: Bend your knees to change levels. Keep your chin tucked.
boxing - 5 counter ko combinations: Defend first, then counter. Stay balanced.
boxing - 5 counterattack ko combinations: Defend first, then counter. Stay balanced.
boxing - 5 ko combinations: Start at 70% speed until it's smooth, then build. Hands back to guard.
boxing - 5 leaping hook combinations: Push off the back foot and land balanced.
boxing - 5 slip and weave combinations: Bend at the knees, not the waist. Eyes on your target.
boxing - 5 uppercut combinations #1: Drive the uppercut from your legs and hips. Keep your other hand on your chin.
boxing - 5 uppercut combinations #2: Drive the uppercut from your legs and hips. Keep your other hand on your chin.
boxing: 3 essential overhand punch set u: Turn the hips over and keep your chin tucked behind your shoulder.
cable tricep rope extension - single arm: Keep your elbow pinned to your side. Only the forearm moves.
chin tuck on wall: Make a double chin by gliding your head straight back. Don't tilt your chin down.
concentric chin up: Pull from a dead hang. Step down rather than lowering.
couch stretch: Squeeze the glute of the back leg and keep your ribs down. Ease in slowly.
cross legged side bend stretch (it band): Push your hip out to the side as you lean. Breathe into it.
deadball shouldering: Lift with your legs and hips, not your back. Alternate shoulders each rep.
decline deficit push up: Keep your body straight and lower your chest below your hands.
dolphin press: Keep your hips high and lower your head slowly.
dumbbell 3 way calf raise: Full range in each foot position: toes in, straight, toes out.
dumbbell alternating push press: Dip and drive with the legs each rep. Don't lean away from the working arm.
dumbbell bent over shoulder extension: Keep your arm straight and your back flat. Squeeze the back of the shoulder at the top.
dumbbell bicep curl with shoulder flexio: Curl first, then raise the arm forward. Keep your ribs down as you lift.
dumbbell curtsy squat: Keep your hips square and chest up.
dumbbell deadlift - single: Keep the dumbbell close to your legs and your back flat.
dumbbell floor pec fly: Keep a slight bend in the elbows. Lower until your upper arms touch the floor.
dumbbell floor press - bent knee: Pause with your upper arms on the floor. Don't bounce.
dumbbell goblet squat: Push your knees out and keep your chest up.
dumbbell incline chest fly - t + y posit: Light weight. Soft elbows in both positions.
dumbbell reverse lunge to step up hip lo: Stay tall at the top with your knee at hip height.
dumbbell single arm shoulder flexion - e: Use your other hand to help it up, then lower over 3 to 5 seconds on your own.
dumbbell split squat: Keep your chest up and front knee over your toes.
dumbbell supinated front raise: Palms up the whole way. Stop at shoulder height and don't swing.
dumbbell walking lunges: Keep your chest up and take controlled steps.
dumbbell wrist deviation curl: Keep your forearm still and move only at the wrist.
dumbbell wrist extension isometric: Hold steady at the effort prescribed. Breathe normally.
dumbbell wrist flexor isometric: Hold steady at the effort prescribed. Breathe normally.
eccentric single leg box squat: Lower over 3 to 5 seconds. Stand up with both legs if needed.
elbow extensor isometrics - triceps: Push at an effort that's strong but no more than mild discomfort. Breathe normally.
elbow plank - around the world: Keep your hips still as you shift your weight.
elevated bodyweight calf raise: Get a full stretch at the bottom and pause at the top.
femoral nerve mobilisation: Gentle and slow. You should feel a stretch, not pins and needles or sharp pain.
foam roller - quadricep mobilisation: Bend and straighten the knee slowly while on a tight spot.
foam roller - thread the needle: Reach long and breathe out as you rotate.
foam roller angels: Keep your lower back flat and arms on the floor as much as you can.
full-body flow #1: Move slowly and smoothly through each position. Breathe throughout.
game - cone - head/shoulder/knees: React to the call as fast as you can. Stay in your stance.
game - shoulder/knee tap sparring: Light taps only. Keep your guard up and feet moving.
ghd back extension - glute dominant: Round your upper back slightly and drive your hips into the pad.
goblet squat with miniband: Push your knees out against the band the whole rep.
grip squeeze - ball: Squeeze hard, hold for the set time, then fully relax before the next rep.
half kneeling band single arm press with: Reach the shoulder blade forward at the end of each press.
half kneeling banded projection - single: Drive forward hard and low out of the kneel.
half kneeling dorsiflexion stretch: Keep your heel down as you drive the knee forward.
half kneeling dumbbell low to high chop: Drive from your hips and keep your trunk tall.
half kneeling kettlebell bottoms up pres: Squeeze the handle hard and keep your wrist straight.
half kneeling kettlebell press: Squeeze the glute of the down leg and keep your ribs down.
half kneeling lunge to rotational scoop: Drive from the back hip. The arms just guide the ball.
half kneeling pallof - drop catch: Catch the band quickly and stop all rotation.
half kneeling plate side bend: Bend only to the side. Keep your hips square.
haltere broad jump: Release the weights at the bottom of the swing and keep your feet clear.
hammer strength belt squat: Keep your chest up and drive through your whole foot.
hang clean high pulls: Arms stay long until your hips fully extend, then pull high.
hang shrug: Keep your arms long and shrug straight up. Drive from the hips, not the arms.
high incline bench dumbbell shoulder pre: Keep your back on the bench and ribs down.
high wide stance leg press: Keep your hips on the seat and knees tracking over your toes.
hip hinge with dowel: Keep the dowel touching your head, upper back and tailbone the whole time.
hollow body hold - bent knee: Press your lower back into the floor the whole hold.
incline bench garhammer raise - straight: Lower your legs as slowly as you can while keeping your lower back on the bench.
incline bench overhead dowel raise - pro: Keep your thumbs up and your shoulders away from your ears. Small lift, big control.
intensive med ball granny toss - single: Max effort. Explode up through the legs and hips, reset between reps.
isometric push-up with towel: Push as hard as you can for the set time. Breathe.
keiser half kneeling bar - pull to punch: Keep your ribs down as you punch across.
knee to chest stretch - lower back: Pull gently and let your back relax into the floor.
knee to opposite shoulder stretch - piri: Pull gently towards the opposite shoulder until you feel it in the buttock.
landmine goblet reverse lunge: Keep your chest up and front knee over your toes.
landmine rocking cossack squat - low han: Stay low as you rock side to side.
landmine row to press: Keep your back flat on the row, then drive through the legs to press.
lateral dumbbell step up: Drive through the top leg. Don't push off the bottom foot.
lumbar rotation stretch: Keep your shoulders on the floor and let your knees drop slowly.
machine standing 3 way calf raise: Full range in each foot position. Pause at the top.
median nerve glide - hand splay: Gentle and slow. Stop before pins and needles.
median nerve glide - mobility: Gentle and slow. Stop before pins and needles.
miniband clams - single leg: Keep your hips stacked and don't roll back. Pause at the top of each rep.
miniband clams - staggered stance: Keep your hips square and move only at the hip.
muay thai - 10 combinations: Start slow and sharp, then build speed. Return to guard after each combo.
muay thai - 10 heavy bag combinations: Turn the hip over on every kick. Hands back to guard.
muay thai - 19 ko combinations: Start slow and sharp, then build speed. Return to guard after each combo.
muay thai - 5 roundhouse body kick combi: Pivot on the standing foot and turn the hip over.
muay thai - 7 heavy bag drills: Work at the intensity prescribed. Breathe out on every strike.
oblique crunch with adductor squeeze - b: Keep squeezing the ball the whole time.
overcoming isometric - hook position: Push into the pad or partner as hard and fast as you can. Keep your guard position tight.
plantar fascia calf raise - knee bent: Put a rolled towel under your toes so they bend back. Lower slowly over 3 seconds.
plantar fascia calf raise - straight leg: Put a rolled towel under your toes so they bend back. Lower slowly over 3 seconds.
plantar fascia calf stretch - knee strai: Pull the toes back to feel it under the foot and in the calf.
plantar mobilisation: Keep the pressure comfortable and roll slowly.
powerband chicken wing: Keep your shoulders low as you drive your elbows back.
powerband terminal knee extension iso ho: Squeeze your quad and hold the knee straight.
prone bench t raise: Thumbs up and squeeze your shoulder blades. Light weight.
prone dumbbell shoulder external rotatio: Keep your elbow fixed at 90 degrees and rotate from the shoulder. Light weight.
push up + lateral slide: Keep your hips level as the hand slides out.
push up + vertical slide: Keep your hips level as the hand slides forward.
quadruped hover + kettlebell drag: Widen your feet and keep your hips still as you drag.
quadruped serratus push up: Arms stay straight. Only your shoulder blades move.
radial nerve glide - mobility: Gentle and slow. Stop before pins and needles.
resisted finger extensor - forearm: Open your fingers fully against the band, then close slowly.
safety bar kang squat: Keep a flat back through the hinge and the squat. Start light.
scap pull up: Arms stay straight. Pull your shoulders down away from your ears.
sciatic nerve mobilisation/glide with a: Gentle and slow. You should feel a stretch, not pins and needles.
seated active shoulder external rotation: Keep your elbow pinned to your side. Push only into a comfortable stretch.
seated ankle plantarflexion & dorsiflexi: Move through the full range slowly. Only the ankle moves.
seated band neck retraction: Glide your head straight back into the band, chin level.
seated barbell good morning: Keep your back flat and hinge from the hips.
seated barbell jump: Explode from the seat. Light load.
seated box jump: Explode from the seat and land softly on the box.
seated calf machine iso hold: Hold the top position without letting your heels sink. Breathe.
seated dorsiflexion stretch - towel: Keep your knee straight and pull the towel gently.
seated hip flexor isometrics: Push at a strong but comfortable effort. Breathe.
seated hip internal rotation with band: Keep your thigh still and move only your foot outward.
seated hip rotation + reach: Sit tall and reach long. Move slowly.
seated knee extension iso on towel: Press the back of your knee into the towel and squeeze your quad.
seated machine 3 way calf raise: Full range in each foot position. Pause at the top.
seated straight-leg raise: Keep the knee locked and sit tall.
short arc quad: Lift slowly and hold the knee straight for 2 seconds.
shoulder abduction mobility: Move only into a comfortable range. Shoulders down.
shoulder external rotation stretch: Ease into it gently. No sharp pain.
shoulder flexion mobilisation hold on sw: Let your chest sink and breathe into the stretch.
shoulder flexion mobility: Keep your ribs down as your arms go overhead.
shoulder internal rotation with towel: Pull gently into a stretch, never sharp pain.
shoulder protraction & retraction on wal: Arms stay straight. Only your shoulder blades move.
shoulder shocker - defranco: Very light weights. Keep your arms straight and shoulders down.
side lying leg abduction: Lead with your heel and keep your toes pointing forward. Don't roll back.
side lying leg adduction: Lift the bottom leg slowly and pause at the top.
side plank + row: Keep your hips up as you row.
side plank reach: Keep your hips up as you reach under.
sidelying dumbbell external rotation: Rolled towel between elbow and ribs. Light weight, slow reps.
single arm push up: Widen your feet for balance and keep your hips square.
single dumbbell skull crusher: Keep your elbows pointing at the ceiling. Lower slowly.
single leg hip flexor iso hold - bench -: Stay tall and keep the knee above hip height for the whole hold.
single leg hip flexor sit up: Keep the other leg flat. Control the lowering.
single leg hip flexor sit up + rotation: Keep the other leg flat. Rotate at the top, then lower slowly.
single leg hip flexor sit up - loaded: Keep the other leg flat. Control the lowering.
single leg lateral box blast: Push hard off the box foot and land balanced.
single leg swiss ball hamstring curl: Keep your hips up as you curl.
sled sprint: Stay low for the first few steps and drive your knees.
slump sciatic nerve mobilisation: Gentle and slow. Stop before pins and needles.
smith machine reverse lunge: Keep your chest up and front knee over your toes.
split stance cable pallof - drop catch: Catch the cable quickly and stop all rotation.
staggered push-up: Swap the hand positions each set.
standing active assisted shoulder abduct: Let the dowel guide the arm. Stop at a comfortable stretch.
standing active assisted shoulder flexio: Let the dowel guide the arm. Stop at a comfortable stretch.
standing cable pallof - drop catch: Catch the cable quickly and stop all rotation.
standing cable pallof press iso hold: Hold the handle at the centre of your chest and don't twist.
standing cable rotations: Rotate through your trunk with straight arms.
standing hip adduction: Stand tall and don't lean as the leg crosses.
standing hip flexion: Stand tall and don't lean back as the knee lifts.
standing kettlebell rotational swing: Power comes from the hips. Keep your back flat.
standing medball drop catch to split sta: Catch the ball fast, then jump straight away.
standing pelvic tilt: Small, slow movement. Keep your upper body still.
standing thoracic cars: Keep your hips still and move only your upper body.
straight arm band external rotation - be: Keep your arms straight and squeeze your shoulder blades together.
supine chin tuck isometric hold: Nod your chin and press the back of your head gently into the floor. Breathe.
supine heel slides with strap: Slide only as far as is comfortable. Use the strap to assist.
swiss ball single leg squat: Keep the ball against the wall and your knee tracking over your toes.
t slide: Sit your hips back and load your glutes as you slide.
t-spine mobilisation + lat stretch: Breathe out as you sink into the stretch.
table slide flexion: Let the table take the weight of your arm. Slide only as far as is comfortable.
tactical frog stretch: Keep your back flat and rock back gently.
tall kneeling keiser x pulldown: Keep your trunk tall and pull your elbows to your hips.
technical stand up: Keep one hand posted and your other hand guarding your face as you stand.

test - bench press 3rm: Use a spotter. Rest 3 to 5 minutes between heavy sets.

test - max lateral bound - right leg: Stick the landing for 2 seconds. Measure to the inside edge. Best of 3.

test - max single leg broad jump - right: Stick the landing for 2 seconds. Measure to the heel. Best of 3.
test - max single leg lateral broad jump: Stick the landing for 2 seconds. Best of 3.

test - single leg squat to bench - right: Count clean reps only. Stop when the knee caves or you drop onto the bench.

thoracic extension arch - bench: Keep your ribs down and extend only through your upper back.
toe elevated bridge: Drive through your heels and squeeze your glutes at the top.
towel isometric squat: Pull up on the towel as hard as you can while pushing through your feet.
towel lateral lunge: Keep your chest up and push back to standing.
trapbar counter-movement jump (cmj): Use a light load that moves fast. Land softly.

trigger release - elbow flexion (lower b: Keep the pressure firm but comfortable and breathe.

trigger release - teres major: Keep the pressure firm but comfortable and breathe.

trigger release - wrist flexors: Keep the pressure firm but comfortable and breathe.
trx push up with a y reach: Keep your body straight as you reach.
ulnar deviation curl: Keep your forearm still and move only at the wrist.
ulnar nerve glide - mobility: Gentle and slow. Stop before pins and needles.
upper-body flow #1: Move slowly and smoothly through each position. Breathe throughout.
walking leg cradle: Stand tall and lift the shin, not just the knee.
wall clam - single leg: Keep your hips square to the wall. Pause at the top.
wall clam - staggered stance: Keep your hips square and move only at the hip.
weighted roman chair side bend: Bend only to the side. Control it back up.
wrist - pronation/supination - mobility: Keep your elbow tucked and move slowly.
wrist extension - mobility: Move slowly through the full range.
wrist extensor stretch: Keep your elbow straight and pull gently.
wrist flexion - mobility: Move slowly through the full range.
wrist flexor stretch: Keep your elbow straight and pull gently.
wrist ulnar & radial deviation - mobilit: Keep your forearm still and move only at the wrist.
